en.title: Carry the Snow Temple yard fight into the next encounter
en.body: The chapter sample keeps one live game as the first three enemies fall, a manual page offers a lesson and four reinforcements enter. Health and progression carry into the next fight, and defeat can be restarted in place.

zh.title: 草料场支持连续两队交战
zh.body: 草料场章节示例沿用同一局游戏。首队三人倒下后可选择残页能力，随后四名援敌按原作顺序入场。林冲的血量和已选能力延续到下一场，落败后可在场内重开。
